{{Top}}
'''Junior Lieutenant''', also known as '''Lieutenant Junior Grade''', was a military rank in the military forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].

This line rank was used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] and was one of the four ranks that together encompass the overall position of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. It ranked above [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]], and below [[Senior Lieutenant/Legends|Senior Lieutenant]]. The rank was the equivalent of [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] Lieutenant and [[Starfighter Corps (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Starfighter Corps]] [[Flight Lieutenant]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

In the [[Alliance Starfighter Corps/Legends|Alliance Starfighter Corps]], post-[[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], it was above [[Flight officer/Legends|Flight Officer]] and below [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. It was identifiable by a gold-trimmed patch on the left shoulder, with a small red dot just to the right of the center.

It was held by [[Vocis Kenit]] immediately after he graduated from the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]] on [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]], during the years just following the creation of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]]. In the [[Galactic Alliance Guard]], it was held by [[Beta Ioli]] and [[Ben Skywalker]].
